AUTHOR: P. Mukherjee; S. Mandal; A. Pediredla
TITLE: UWOT-Net: Underwater Object Tracking by Attention Driven Network in Unconstrained Marine Environments
REGION: BrackishMOT (fixed camera, brackish water; location not stated in paper) plus web-sourced UTB180 and GMOT-40 videos
SPECIES: BrackishMOT classes: fish, small fish, crab, shrimp/prawn, starfish, jellyfish; GMOT-40 fish category; UTB180 mixed underwater objects
DATA: BrackishMOT (98 sequences), GMOT-40 (fish category, 4 videos), UTB180 (180 videos)
V_EV: Sec. III-B: 'for the GMOT40 and UTB180 datasets, the original image is fed directly to the encoder since these datasets are not degraded by turbidity and backlight scattering.'
D2: BrackishMOT 78 train / 20 test sequences; GMOT-40 3 train / 1 test fish videos; UTB180 130 train / 50 test sequences
D_EV: Sec. IV-B: 'Our model underwent training on 78 sequences and was then assessed on 20 additional sequences dedicated to testing its performance.'
R_EV: Sec. IV-B: each dataset is trained and tested separately (BrackishMOT 78/20 sequences, GMOT-40 3/1 videos, UTB180 130/50); no cross-dataset evaluation.
C_EV: Sec. IV-C: 'the newly proposed model has notably diminished the frequency of ID switches across all the datasets (See Tables: I, II, V)'; Table III reports IDs vs GT IDs per sequence.
E_EV: Tables I-V report only 'HOTA MOTA MOTP MT PT ML IDs' tracking metrics.
ARCH: RAUNE-Net underwater enhancement + ResNet-50 backbone + deformable-DETR transformer encoder-decoder tracking-by-attention (TrackFormer-style; TrTr-style SOT head)
METR: HOTA, MOTA, MOTP, MT, PT, ML, ID counts/ID switches
NOTE: Included because BrackishMOT (eligible monitoring dataset) results are reported; GMOT-40 and UTB180 are web-sourced benchmark videos. Brackish model trained from scratch (PRE=없음); UTB180 fine-tuned from COCO-DETR / CrowdHuman+MOT17 weights. Split stated per sequence; unclear whether the 78/20 BrackishMOT split is the dataset's predefined split. C5 coded from measured ID switches/ID counts (no detection threshold reported) -> C_ALL=P. Paper evaluates 'with ground truth detections' per Sec. III, which is ambiguous. DSHR=공개 because only public datasets were used.
